comparison.conventional_baseline: The bogart pilot itself (catherine-hc6, bogart-4wt): the selector ambiguity census that found the 3 real collisions — a rule-based script over the same corpus (prototype/bogart_storage_granularity.py --census, committed before the run), not a re-executed check arm on this fixture; no baseline-arm uniqueness claim is made, unique_detections is empty.

expressibility_gap.why: the stored-column model expresses each capture's selector and artifact reference, but the check surface (path equations + totality over stored arrows) has no cardinality claim: two capture rows resolving to one selector (or one artifact) is not a violation of any declared equation, and declaring the collision as an equation would be a derived relation, not stored state (the P3 boundary). The rule-based census detects it; the model check cannot.
